But this revolutionary therapy has had little impact on solid tumours like sarcoma, the third most common cancer in children. Now, a world-first trial at The Kids Research Institute Australia could change that – all with the help of man’s best friend. The busy pre-surgery area of Perth Veterinary Specialists in Osborne Park is perhaps the last place you’d expect to be ground zero for a clinical trial that could save the lives of thousands of kids around the world.
